item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gru ru'i thugs bcud las nyams khrid 'phrul mdzod zhu bIdzA lan bzhi pa lung bstan dri med phreng ba
item.coloph: ces slob dpon thugs sgrab 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ nyams khrid 'phrul gyi mdzod phug las/ lha sras rgyal pos zhus pa'i bon/ dri med shel gyi gzhong pa'i nang / nor bu rin chen bkang nas phul/ khrid gsum gnas kyi man ngag dri med nor bu shel phreng zhes bya ba'i le'u ste/ bzhi pa'o/ rig 'dzin chen po byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis (gyi) snyan du brgyud pa mu tsug smar ro//
